name.en: Suspense item clearance and ageing (worldwide PFM)
name.hi: उचंत मद निपटान एवं आयु निगरानी (अंतरराष्ट्रीय सार्वजनिक वित्त)

description: A suspense item (PFM-051, PEFA PI-27) is cleared to the correct head within the clearance period from DMN; the period is guarded by an SLA that escalates; an item that cannot be cleared becomes a write-off proposal that another officer approves; the reclassification is posted through the ledger and is confirmed before the case closes. Periods are SYNTHETIC until the country confirms them.

connectors.purpose: Reclassify the item from suspense to the correct head
